snapshot.title: PWA game-focused layout when installed
snapshot.description: When the app is opened as an installed PWA (fullscreen/standalone display mode), show a minimal header with an Exit button and let the game iframe fill the remaining viewport height. Implemented in react-shell.js.

acceptanceCriteria.text: isPwaMode() correctly detects fullscreen, standalone, and iOS standalone
PWA mode renders slim top bar with Exit button and game iframe filling 100svh
Exit button navigates back in history or closes the tab

changes.newValue: ✓ AC1-3 implemented in react-shell.js; expanded PWA detection to standalone/fullscreen/minimal-ui + iOS standalone + fullscreen element; ensured 100svh/min-height container + safe-area header + iframe full-height fill.
